subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw adopt streaming node invokes plus nodeHost.agentRuns.claude.enabled as permanent core protocol and configuration contracts for paired-node Claude execution?
rationale: This introduces a security-sensitive execution mode, a user-visible config option, two gateway wire messages, session placement semantics, and mixed-version operational behavior that tests cannot establish as intended product policy.

options.title: Accept the narrowed core feature
options.body: Approve the protocol and config direction after the exact-argv defect is fixed, the spawn helper stays internal, conflicts are resolved, and live fresh-install plus upgrade proof is supplied.

options.title: Split transport from Claude placement
options.body: Land the generic streaming invoke contract separately and defer Claude catalog continuation until its approval, configuration, and node lifecycle contract is reviewed independently.

options.title: Defer paired-node agent runs
options.body: Keep paired-node catalog sessions view-only and close or supersede this implementation until a smaller supported execution architecture is selected.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed core feature
recommendation.body: Approve the protocol and config direction after the exact-argv defect is fixed, the spawn helper stays internal, conflicts are resolved, and live fresh-install plus upgrade proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature design, linked issue, branch implementation, and recently merged catalog-session work all route through this contributor.
